name: booking_release
description: Release (cancel) a booking slot the caller currently holds. Guarded: only succeeds if the slot is actually held by this caller. When the caller wants to MOVE a booking, call booking_reserve for the new slot first, then release the old one only if the reserve succeeded — a failed move keeps the original.

slot_id.description: Identifier of the slot to release (e.g. the caller's last_booking_slot from memory_load).

caller_id.description: Caller phone number in E.164 form, or an anonymous call id.
